main.description: Community metadata (chat links, and future extensible fields) that an authenticated atproto identity attaches to a code-forge repository it administers. Discovery is via a backlink index on 'subject'; every record is independently verified before its links are shown.

host.description: Host for self-hosted instances. Omit for the provider's canonical host.

owner.description: Repository owner (user or organisation) on the forge.

subject.description: Canonical, lowercase repository URL. Used as the backlink target so readers can reverse-resolve which identities have attached metadata to a repo.

links.description: Community links (chat servers, forums, etc.) shown on the repository page.

attestation.description: Compact JWS (ES256) issued by the koinon server proving the record owner's DID held admin access to this repo when signed. Its payload asserts { sub: <owner did>, provider, owner, name, host? }. Absent for Tangled, where ownership is proven by the record owner being the repo's atproto DID. Verified against the issuer's JWKS.

attestedBy.description: Origin of the koinon server that issued 'attestation'. Its public keys are published at '<attestedBy>/.well-known/jwks.json'. Verifiers must pin this to a trusted issuer.

service.description: Service identifier used to pick an icon, e.g. 'discord', 'slack', 'matrix', 'zulip', 'website'.

url.description: Link target. Must be an http(s) URL.

label.description: Optional human-friendly label; defaults to the service or host name.
